recommendations.recommendation: Index the reference by simulated time, not by step count. Compute ref_idx = min(len-1, round(t_sim / ref_dt)) (ref_dt from the npz 'dt'; unified refset is 0.01 s, env control step is 0.02 s) and define phase = ref_time / clip_duration so phase 1.0 = end of the clip.
recommendations.rationale: DeepMimic defines phase phi in [0,1] as progress through the clip and syncs it to the reference clock; PHC/GMT/BeyondMimic all run reference and policy on the same clock. On origin/main the env sets ref_idx = episode_steps (control step 0.02 s) and ignores reference['dt'], so a 0.01 s reference plays at 2x speed and a 200-step episode covers only 2.0 s of reference; phase = steps/max_steps is unrelated to clip length. This is read-only evidence from a5df07b; Trainer's uncommitted edits may already fix it.
recommendations.unverified_notes: whether the 0.4 s bug mentioned by the Orchestrator is this issue is not verified here
recommendations.acceptance_check: unit test: constructing env with a 0.01 s reference, after 50 control steps ref_idx==100 and ref time == sim time

recommendations.recommendation: Use reference-state initialization: reset to a state sampled from the clip (pose AND velocity, set club/ball consistent), uniform over phase at first, then adaptive. Keep a fraction (e.g. 20%) of resets at phase 0 so address-position starts are still trained.
recommendations.rationale: DeepMimic Table 5: RSI is vital for dynamic skills with flight/ballistic phases (backflip 0.379 without RSI vs 0.791 with RSI+ET); PHC, KungfuBot and BeyondMimic all use RSI. A golf downswing is a ballistic-like fast phase that is hard to reach from address under exploration noise.
recommendations.unverified_notes: the 20% address-start fraction is an engineering choice, not from a paper
recommendations.acceptance_check: after change, episodes starting at phase >=0.5 reach impact within the first 0.5 s of sim

recommendations.recommendation: Replace torso-height-only termination with a tracking-error termination that is loose early and tightens: terminate when mean key-body error > E(c) where E goes 0.6 m -> 0.25 m as the clip is completed repeatedly, plus a fall check (base height / gravity projection). Do NOT terminate on club-head error alone; do not terminate after ball contact for the remaining follow-through unless fallen.
recommendations.rationale: GMT tightens the threshold per clip from 0.6 to 0.25 with completion count; BeyondMimic terminates on |z error|>0.25 m or anchor orientation >0.8 rad; H2O terminates at base height<0.3 m, gravity proj>0.7, mean link error>0.5 m; PHC uses 0.5 m with relaxed ankle/toe; DeepMimic ET on torso/head contact is critical. SMPLOlympics golf ET adds: ball moves backward, no contact within 2 s, ball too close to body.

parameters.gate: completion count c: c0=10, x0.99 per completed clip, min 1 (GMT)
golf_extra: no club contact within 2 s => end

recommendations.unverified_notes: units of GMT E_i not stated in the text read; thresholds for a G1-scale model unverified; 2 s no-contact window is for SMPLOlympics golf and our swings last ~1.5-2.7 s
recommendations.acceptance_check: unit test: perturbed reference drives early termination; pin_torso mode still terminates on tracking error

recommendations.recommendation: Split the imitation reward into separate exponential terms with explicit scales instead of one exp(-mean(err^2)/0.5): joint position, joint velocity, key-body (club head, both hands) position, root/pelvis orientation, optionally COM. Start from DeepMimic weights (0.65 pose, 0.1 vel, 0.15 end-effector, 0.1 COM) with club head as the key end-effector; keep rewards bounded in [0,1].
recommendations.rationale: DeepMimic and PHC both use per-quantity exponentials including velocity terms; GMT and BeyondMimic weight all terms uniformly. Our env currently has one joint-position term (units radians, /0.5) + club_head term (1.5, /0.5) and no velocity term, so it cannot represent a fast-but-wrong-timed swing.

parameters.sigmas_note: start sigma from BeyondMimic (pos 0.3, ori 0.4, vel 1.0) then adapt (R05)

recommendations.unverified_notes: the specific weight split above is a starting point derived by us, NOT from a paper; our joint vector is 11-D degrees->rad, not a full-body keypoint set
recommendations.acceptance_check: ablation on one clip: joint-vel term on vs off, report tracking error and time-to-impact error

recommendations.recommendation: Make each tracking sigma adaptive: sigma <- min(sigma, EMA of current tracking error) starting from a large sigma_init, non-increasing.
recommendations.rationale: KungfuBot derives sigma* = mean optimal tracking error and implements a closed-loop EMA rule so reward stays sensitive as the policy improves; avoids hand tuning for noisy video-derived references.

parameters.ema_decay_note: EMA rate not extracted from paper

recommendations.unverified_notes: EMA decay and sigma_init values not extracted; check on a held-out clip before trusting
recommendations.acceptance_check: sigma monotonic non-increasing in logs; tracking error decreases

recommendations.recommendation: Add three light regularizers, ramped in after tracking works: action-rate penalty, joint-limit penalty (soft limit 0.9x), and an energy/power penalty -0.0005*sum|torque*joint_vel|^2 that is switched OFF (or scaled to 0.1) in a window around impact.
recommendations.rationale: BeyondMimic uses exactly action-rate, joint-limit (0.9 soft limit) and self-contact penalties; PHC uses the -0.0005 energy term to remove jitter; OmniH2O introduces its feet-height regularizer via curriculum. The impact-window exemption is our inference: a 130-150 mph target needs near-peak torque (see repo power profile: wrist torque margin).
recommendations.unverified_notes: weights from BeyondMimic are for a 29-DoF G1 with PD actions; transfer to our torque-controlled env is unverified; impact window values are ours
recommendations.acceptance_check: reward component logs show regularizer total < 20% of tracking reward in downswing

recommendations.recommendation: Add the club-ball impact/task reward ON TOP of tracking with a bounded weight (start 0.7 tracking : 0.3 task) and gate it by the reference impact event. Pre-contact: r_c = exp(-100*||p_ball-p_club||^2) (SMPLOlympics golf), post-contact: 1 for contact + predicted-landing/carry term. For power: reward exp(-(v_club_impact - v_target)^2/s^2) with v_target from the 350yd ladder (120->130->140->150 mph).
recommendations.rationale: DeepMimic: imitation-only success 5%/19% vs 75%/99% with the task term (throw/strike), weights 0.7/0.3 for all tasks; AMP uses 0.5/0.5; SMPLOlympics golf reward = position+contact+goal+predicted landing, all weight 1, with the 100x contact kernel; PhysHOI's contact-graph reward and Vid2Player's pre/post contact reward split support timing the contact term to the reference impact event. Our env's contact term exp(-3*dist) is a much wider linear-distance kernel than exp(-100*d^2) and is not gated by contact timing.
recommendations.unverified_notes: speed_sigma 5 mph and the speed-target reward form are ours (no paper reports a club-speed reward); tennis items are snippet-level
recommendations.acceptance_check: eval on unified refset val split: contact rate and club speed at impact reported per ladder step

recommendations.recommendation: Stage the training and gate stages on success rate, not timesteps: A) pure tracking (task weight 0) until >=80% of val clips complete without termination; B) add contact reward; C) add carry/direction; D) climb the speed ladder 120->130->140->150 mph only after C is stable. Existing set_progress() ramp in the env can implement the gating.
recommendations.rationale: DeepMimic progressive training; Vid2Player tennis three-stage curriculum (approach -> fixed targets -> continuous targets, snippet-level); GMT completion-level curriculum; OmniH2O curriculum for regularizers; SMPLOlympics says contact initiation is the hard sparse-exploration step.
recommendations.acceptance_check: stage transitions logged with the success metric that triggered them

recommendations.recommendation: Use performance-based adaptive sampling over phase bins and over clips: sample start phase and clip in proportion to recent failure rate (EMA), with a uniform floor so easy segments are not forgotten; use bins of 0.25 s for 1.5-2.7 s swings (BeyondMimic uses 1 s bins for minutes-long motions).
recommendations.rationale: BeyondMimic: without adaptive sampling 3 of 4 motions fail hard segments after 30k iterations; GMT: removing adaptive sampling worsens every metric (Table 2); PHC hard-negative mining.

parameters.clip_weights: unified refset 0.6 Mason / 0.2 MultiSense / 0.2 CMU as prior

recommendations.unverified_notes: 0.25 s bin size is ours; the other numbers are BeyondMimic's
recommendations.acceptance_check: sampling histogram concentrates on downswing/impact bins early, flattens later

recommendations.recommendation: Run a feasibility filter over the unified refset before long training: train/evaluate a quick privileged tracker (no DR) per clip and flag clips it cannot track within the R03 tolerance; down-weight or drop them. Also smooth video-derived references (EMA) and check dt consistency per clip.
recommendations.rationale: H2O 'sim-to-data' keeps ~8.5k of 10k AMASS clips; GMT two-stage curation (rule-based + preliminary policy completion rate); KungfuBot physics-based filter + EMA smoothing; this directly serves the Orchestrator's request to audit for timing errors.
recommendations.acceptance_check: report listing clips flagged; per-clip dt and duration table

recommendations.recommendation: Move from direct torque (ctrl = action*torque_scale) to PD-target actions at the sim rate, with gains from kp=I*w^2, kd=2*I*zeta*w (zeta=2, w = 2*pi*10 Hz class) using actuator armature, action scale 0.25*tau_max/kp. The env already has a _substep_ctrl hook for per-substep PD.
recommendations.rationale: DeepMimic, AMP, PHC, BeyondMimic, GMT all use PD-target actions; PHC keeps actions absolute (not residual on reference) for robustness to noisy references; BeyondMimic: zero armature causes overswing.
recommendations.unverified_notes: BeyondMimic's 10 Hz is for G1 joints; a swing needs much higher wrist bandwidth so tune per joint (unverified); BeyondMimic states natural frequency 10 Hz, not whether in rad/s
recommendations.acceptance_check: step response test per joint: overshoot < 10%

recommendations.recommendation: Give the policy phase (progress of clip) plus a short future reference window (next 3-5 frames at 0.04-0.1 s, including club-head target) and the previous action; use 6D rotation for orientations if quaternions are fed.
recommendations.rationale: DeepMimic/KungfuBot include phase; GMT: next-frame-only is worse than next+2 s window, window-only is worst; TWIST: single-frame students are hesitant, privileged-future teachers smoother; BeyondMimic: Rot6D beats quaternion for sim-to-real, history hurt in their setup.
recommendations.unverified_notes: GMT's window is 2 s; for a 1.5-2.7 s swing we propose a much shorter lookahead - unverified
recommendations.acceptance_check: ablation: no window vs window, tracking error at impact

recommendations.recommendation: Keep randomization minimal and physically grounded: friction (0.3-1.6), joint zero offsets (+-0.01 rad), torso COM (+-0.025/0.05 m), small action delay <=20 ms, push velocities; add club-specific ones (grip slip, club mass +-5%, ball restitution) only for sim-to-sim robustness tests.
recommendations.rationale: BeyondMimic: compact DR preserves agility; GMT table of ranges; both stress that latency matters (BeyondMimic: 10 ms delay fails 2 of 3 hardware trials; GMT randomizes delay 0-20 ms).
recommendations.acceptance_check: policy evaluated at nominal + 3 perturbed settings, success drop reported

recommendations.recommendation: Raise PPO batch/parallelism and set gamma 0.95-0.99, GAE lambda 0.95, clip 0.2. Current train_ppo.py: n_envs=4, n_steps=2048, batch_size=64, n_epochs=10, gamma=0.99, lr 3e-4 (SB3 defaults-like).
recommendations.rationale: DeepMimic used batch 4096 / minibatch 256 / gamma 0.95 / lambda 0.95 / clip 0.2 and ~60M samples (2 days, 8 CPU cores); PHC gamma 0.99; GMT 4096 envs. This box has no GPU and 8 CPU cores, so expect DeepMimic-order sample budgets to take days.
recommendations.unverified_notes: no paper verifies these for a MuJoCo CPU env with 11 joints
recommendations.acceptance_check: learning curves over 3 seeds, mean tracking error

recommendations.recommendation: Give tracking and impact/task rewards separate value heads (reward vectorization) or at least normalize each term, because the sparse impact reward and dense tracking reward have very different scales.
recommendations.rationale: KungfuBot vectorizes rewards with a value head per term; BeyondMimic uses an asymmetric critic with privileged per-body poses.
recommendations.unverified_notes: SB3 PPO does not support multi-head critics out of the box; would need a custom policy or an RL library change (not verified)

recommendations.recommendation: If tracking + task reward cannot create ball contact (sparse exploration), try a latent-space hierarchical policy (PULSE-style) or pretrain a swing-skill prior; do not rely on plain AMP.
recommendations.rationale: SMPLOlympics: only PULSE and PULSE+AMP solved golf consistently; PPO and AMP produced inhuman strategies; AMP can ignore task reward.
recommendations.unverified_notes: SMPL humanoid + GPU scale, not directly our G1; PULSE repo has no detected license

recommendations.recommendation: Defer sim-to-real tricks (teacher->student distillation, latency model, armature identification) until the sim tracker meets success gates; then: privileged teacher with future frames, student single-frame with 5-25 step history, 2-5 ms latency discipline.
recommendations.rationale: TWIST/GMT/OmniH2O teacher-student; BeyondMimic latency ablation; GMT armature = k^2*I.
recommendations.unverified_notes: history lengths differ by paper (5, 20, 25) and BeyondMimic found history hurt; unverified for golf

torso height<0.4 (disabled if pin_torso) or max_steps; no tracking-error ET
2.0*exp(-mean(sq joint err rad)/0.5) (+1.5*exp(-club_err/0.5) in legacy); no velocity/orientation/COM terms
